title: Update Endpoint
description: This API can be used to change the destination URL, configured events, signing secret, and the enabled status of the webhook endpoint.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the endpoint that is returned by the [Create Endpoint](../create-endpoint) or the [List Endpoints](../list-endpoints) API.

disabled.description: If present and true, the given endpoint will be disabled and stop receiving events. Otherwise, the given endpoint will be enabled.

event_name.description:
The name of an event. There is a fixed set of supported event names, each representing
a different kind of event that can be sent to a webhook endpoint. This is the same value
that is sent to a webhook endpoint, in the "eventName" field of the request payload.

subcategory.description:
Optional subcategory. Some event types require further specifying a subcategory. For
example, the "recording.event.custom" event requires specifying a particular
custom event as the subcategory. This field will be empty for kinds of events that
do not require a subcategory. When specified, this needs to be the `subcategory` returned
from [List Event Subcategories](../list-event-subcategories) and not the `display_name`.

event_types.description: The new set of event types that the endpoint should receive. If absent or an empty list, the set of events will not be changed.

url.description: The new URL for the endpoint. Note that changing the URL also changes the ID of the endpoint. See the `id` property in the response for the endpoint's new ID. If absent or an empty string, the URL will not be changed.

secret.description: The new secret for the endpoint used for signing payloads. If absent or an empty string, the secret will not be changed.

id.description: A unique ID for the endpoint

created.description: The time when the endpoint was created

modified.description: The time when the endpoint was last modified

enabled.description: Whether or not this endpoint is active

url.description: The destination URL of this endpoint
